question: Should phase-one URL preview become a supported bundled Workspaces builtin once the binding, state, localization, and proof blockers are resolved?
rationale: The implementation adds a permanent user-facing iframe capability with a security boundary; code review can validate mechanics but cannot decide whether this surface belongs in the supported bundled product.

options.title: Sponsor the bounded builtin
options.body: Accept phase one in Workspaces after the remaining correctness fixes, locale synchronization, and live security/UX proof are supplied.

options.title: Pause pending broader preview design
options.body: Keep the canonical feature issue open but pause this PR until dev-server lifecycle and browser-backed inspection requirements establish the permanent API shape.

options.title: Decline bundled preview
options.body: Close the implementation direction and retain iframe embedding only through the existing generic widget surface.

recommendation.title: Sponsor the bounded builtin
recommendation.body: Accept phase one in Workspaces after the remaining correctness fixes, locale synchronization, and live security/UX proof are supplied.

likelyOwner.reason: The unresolved choice concerns permanent Control UI product scope and browser security policy rather than a mechanical contributor repair.
